packages.title: From outside the app: an entry never closes a sheet holding a recording, and lands only in a form it would open itself
brief: Round 3 of P308 (UX-2110, UX-2637; both verified fixed at widget level in round 2, verify-b3-r2-A.md). Its two regressions, both S2, both in the same check in `_openEntries` (App/lib/main.dart ~:189-213), go together. Keep everything P292 and P308 built: `_entrySheets`; `_CaptureSheetRoute._open`, `_empty`, `_typing` and `_markEmpty` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart ~:2262-2270, called each build at ~:2284); `CaptureMode` and `emptyCaptureSheetOnTop` (~:205-221); `captureOpensForm` (~:160-163), still shared by `showCaptureSheet` and `_openEntries`; `NewTaskRoute` with `_open` and `empty` (App/lib/screens/edit_task_screen.dart ~:111-141) and TaskEditor's `_markEmpty` (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart ~:317-336, unchanged by this package); `_notices` in App/lib/widgets/task_form_entry.dart (~:43-72, :95-112). The 'P292 · one sheet per double tap' and 'P308 · one entry, one sheet or form' groups (App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart :3457, :3835; App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart :3843) keep passing. No copy, no ARB change, no Kotlin, no change to TaskEditor.

UX-2641 (R2A-1), what P308 did and why it fails: a capture sheet counts as empty when it has no result and `!_hasWords` (~:2284). In online listening (`_goOnline`, ~:1357-1367, when the phone's recognizer couldn't start) no live words show, but the sheet keeps a recording (`_keepAudio` sets the session's `audioPath` from the first amplitude event, ~:900-912, :1303). Leaving the app pauses it with its audio (`_restingPhase`, ~:1420-1424). A later TEXT entry then meets an 'empty' voice sheet of the other mode and `navigator.pop()`s it (main.dart ~:212) without the keep-or-discard question its own Cancelar asks (`_cancel` tests `_hasInput`, which counts `audioPath`, ~:1854-1855, :2093). `dispose` keeps the recording in Capturas pendientes, out of view. The same holds for a typing sheet kept from a recording (Escribir → keep).

UX-2641, the fix, settled here: closing and absorbing are two different tests. Absorbing an entry into a sheet of its own mode loses nothing, so keep it on the current test (no result, no words), which also keeps a double tap in online listening to one sheet: the reviewer's one-word change (`_markEmpty(result == null && !_hasInput)`) would make an online sheet non-empty within 120 ms of opening, and a second VOICE tap would stack a second listening sheet, UX-2110 again. Closing a sheet of the other mode (rule (4)) needs the stricter test, the sheet's own: nothing said or typed, `!_hasInput`. So: give `_CaptureSheetRoute` a third flag next to `_empty` and `_typing`, for example `bool _recorded` (the sheet keeps a recording: `_session?.audioPath != null`), set in the same `_markEmpty` call each build. `_keepAudio` stores the session inside `_writes` without a setState, so also set the flag right after it stores `_session` there (for example through a small helper that reads `ModalRoute.of(context)` when `mounted`), so the flag is true as soon as the audio is kept, not only at the next build. Add a public function for main.dart, for example `bool emptyCaptureSheetOnTopRecorded(NavigatorState navigator)` (the empty sheet on top keeps a recording), or return a record from `emptyCaptureSheetOnTop`; keep the doc comments true. In `_openEntries`, pop the other mode's empty sheet only when it keeps no recording; when it keeps one, open the entry's own sheet or form over it, as before P308, so the paused sheet with the recording shows again on Cancelar.

UX-2642 (R2A-2), what P308 did and why it fails: `emptyNewTaskFormOnTop` (edit_task_screen.dart ~:138-141) matches any `/newTask` with an empty title, and `_notices` any used-up notice. (a) Free account, 0 dictations left (or no count from the server, so no mic): a TEXT entry's form (`askedToSpeak: false`, main.dart ~:251) absorbs a later VOICE entry, so the widget's mic shows a form without the used-up line (`_noMic`, task_editor.dart ~:912-914, :1278) that a VOICE entry's own form shows. (b) An empty form opened in the app by TaskActions (App/lib/widgets/task_actions.dart:83-89) on a picked day in Calendar (`calendar_screen.dart:1149`), on the day timeline, or on a shared project's page with a person chip on (`home_screen.dart:928`) absorbs a widget or shortcut entry, so the task then added goes to that day, list and person.

UX-2642, the fix, settled here. An entry's own form is one pushed with `NewTaskArguments` that have `day`, `projectId`, `person` and `captureId` null and `words` empty (main.dart ~:251 passes only `showCalendar` and `askedToSpeak`). The route already carries them: read `settings.arguments as NewTaskArguments?` in edit_task_screen.dart (null counts as `const NewTaskArguments()`); no new field is needed. Replace `emptyNewTaskFormOnTop(navigator)` with one that answers which kind of entry form waits on top, for example `bool? emptyEntryFormOnTop(NavigatorState navigator)` returning the top form's `askedToSpeak` when the current route is a `NewTaskRoute` that is `empty` and has those arguments, and null otherwise; keep its doc true. Its only caller is `emptyTaskFormOnTop` in task_form_entry.dart (check with grep). Then, for an entry that would open the form (`captureOpensForm(..., typing: !voice)` true): (1) a TEXT entry is absorbed by an empty entry form of either kind (the used-up line on a VOICE entry's form is still true); (2) a VOICE entry is absorbed only by an empty entry form with `askedToSpeak` true; (3) the used-up notice absorbs either kind only when it was opened with those same entry arguments: give `_Notice` that fact (for example `bool fromEntry`, set in `openTaskForm` from its own arguments: no `day`, `projectId`, `person`, `captureId`, empty `words`). The notice says itself that dictations are used up, so a VOICE entry absorbed by a TEXT entry's notice is accepted. Never pop a notice.

UX-2642, closing first: an empty entry form (as defined above, never one with a day, project, person, words or capture) that does not absorb the entry is popped first (`navigator.pop()`, it's the current route), as rule (4) does for sheets. Back on a form with no title just closes (D12, `_back`, task_editor.dart ~:561-567), and an entry's form has no words to let go of, so nothing is lost. This covers: a VOICE entry onto an empty TEXT entry form with 0 left (pop, then the VOICE entry's own form, with the used-up line: one form), and, the reviewer's 'not a regression' note, a VOICE entry with dictations left onto an empty TEXT entry form (pop, then the listening sheet: Cancelar → Calendar, no empty form under it). Any other empty form (an in-app one with a day, a project, a person, words or a capture) is never popped or absorbed: the entry opens its own over it, as before P308, and Back shows the in-app form. This also closes the reviewer's second 'not a regression' note: a share's form (with words) between push and TaskEditor's first build no longer absorbs a TEXT entry.

`_openEntries` (main.dart ~:189-213): compute both checks before acting, in this order: absorb (same-mode empty sheet; or an entry that would open the form with an absorbing entry form or notice on top) → acknowledge and continue; else pop the empty sheet of the other mode when it keeps no recording, or the empty entry form that didn't absorb; then open as today. Keep the comment above it true and name UX-2641 and UX-2642. Shares still always open their own. A VOICE entry onto an empty voice sheet that is idle or paused still leaves it showing as it is (P292). `openTaskForm` still returns at once for its other callers.

Housekeeping, name only: P292's test at App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart:3488 ('UX-2110: a shortcut’s TEXT entry while the widget’s empty sheet waits opens no second sheet either') now describes the old behaviour; P308 closes the voice sheet and a typing sheet replaces it. Rename it to say so (for example 'UX-2110 / UX-2637: a shortcut’s TEXT entry while the widget’s empty sheet waits leaves one sheet, typing'); don't change its assertions.

Tests (ux-tester writes the acceptance tests): Pro sheet cases in a group 'P313 · an entry never closes what holds something' at the end of main() in App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart, or in App/test/native_speech_test.dart if only its harness can force online listening (its test 'UX-603 / UX-1306: after a failed native start, the sheet listens online…' at :1723 does); free-account form cases in a group of the same name at the end of main() in App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart. Device: the real widget and shortcuts aren't reachable here; say what the emulator should check.
acceptance: Pro, ES 1× on 360×800, online listening (the phone's recognizer fails to start): a VOICE entry opens the sheet; audio is recorded and then paused (the app is sent to the background), no words show; a TEXT entry → a typing sheet opens over it; Cancelar on the typing sheet shows the paused voice sheet; the capture is still there, not discarded, and no keep-or-discard question was skipped.
Pro, online listening: two VOICE entries 300 ms apart → exactly one capture sheet, still listening (the double tap stays absorbed while the sheet keeps audio).
Pro, native listening, nothing heard: a VOICE entry, then a TEXT entry 300 ms later → one capture sheet, typing (P308's case still passes).

Free account with 0 dictations left, the used-up notice already seen this month, ES 1×: a TEXT entry opens the form; with nothing typed, a VOICE entry → exactly one TaskEditor on screen, showing the used-up line (`free-voice-used-up`); Back → Calendar.
Free account with 0 dictations left: a VOICE entry opens the form with the used-up line; with nothing typed, a TEXT entry → still one TaskEditor (absorbed); Back → Calendar.

Free account (0 left, or with dictations left): Calendar with a later day picked, «Nueva tarea» tapped and left empty (its form shows that day), then a TEXT entry → a second form on top, with no day preset (today's date); Back on it shows the first form with the picked day.
Free account: on a shared project's page with a person's chip on, «Nueva tarea» left empty, then a TEXT entry → a second form on top with no project and no person set; Back shows the first form.
Free account with dictations left: a TEXT entry opens the form; with nothing typed, a VOICE entry → the listening sheet, and no form under it: Cancelar → Calendar.
Free account, two TEXT entries 300 ms apart → one TaskEditor; two VOICE entries 300 ms apart with 0 left → one TaskEditor (P308's tests still pass).
A share entry still opens its own sheet or form, and a TEXT entry right behind a share (both pending) opens a second, empty form over the shared words' form, which keeps its words.
deviceChecks: TaskFlow_Review emulator, free account with 0 dictations left: tap «Escribir una tarea» from the launcher shortcut, go Home, tap the widget's mic → one form, with «no quedan dictados…»; Back → Calendar.
Emulator, free account: in Calendar pick a later day, tap «Nueva tarea», go Home, tap «Escribir una tarea» → a form with no day on top; Back shows the picked day's form.

Emulator, Pro, only if online listening can be forced (no offline speech pack for the Voz language): tap the widget's mic, say a few words, go Home, tap «Escribir una tarea» → a typing sheet; Cancelar shows the paused voice sheet with its recording.
